About this app

Gaming Zone bundles a set of fast, pick-up-and-play arcade games into a single Android app. Jump between reflex challenges, number puzzles and endless runners from one home screen, track your best scores, and pick up coins as you go.

  • Glow Runner
  • Infinite Runner
